yaml:
# HISS scrape access (RKE2 readiness stage plan 2026-10-24, plan §4.1 AL-P5). NetworkPolicies that let Prometheus
# (monitoring, app.kubernetes.io/name=prometheus) reach the metrics ports of ingress-nginx and cert-manager, for the
# ServiceMonitors of alert design stage A4.
#
# Setup applies each policy only where it is needed: when an existing NetworkPolicy already isolates the selected Pods
# for ingress. A NetworkPolicy that selects a Pod makes that Pod deny every ingress it does not list, so applying one of
# these to a namespace without policies would cut the ingress controller's 80/443 traffic and cert-manager's webhook. In
# a namespace whose Pods are not isolated, Prometheus already reaches the port and Setup reports NotNeeded.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-prometheus-scrape
  namespace: ingress-nginx
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ingress-nginx
      app.kubernetes.io/component: controller
  policyTypes: ["Ingress"]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: monitoring
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: prometheus
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 10254
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: opensphere-prometheus-scrape
  namespace: cert-manager
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: opensphere-console
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: OpenSphere-Setup
    opensphere.io/authority: hiss-chart-execution-v1
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: cert-manager
  policyTypes: ["Ingress"]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: monitoring
          podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app.kubernetes.io/name: prometheus
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 9402
